views.task_interaction: 准备并持久化冻结文档 -> prepared -> run启动时钟 -> Host状态提交 -> 同来源/修订观察与回看 -> 保存交接
views.structure_data: ExecutionFrozenInputs + immutable state records + Snapshot observation_frontier; no RunResult coercion
views.state_behavior: prepared clock not started; first run anchors monotonic time once; reads never advance or execute Engine
views.interface_collaboration: H09 local read, H08 explicit cloud reads C16/C17, native exact-asset binary reader, TX01/TX06/TX07
views.ui_presentation: third execution source in existing canvases/dock; item/job/device at fixed time; unknown progress remains static
views.deployment_verification: local managed archive plus cloud frozen JSON/state records; existing model media shipped with project; all runtime checks deferred

decisions.subject: 冻结输入文档及素材归属
decisions.selected: Host捕获实际Engine输入、精确模块和AssetRef映射；Native受管归档保存媒体字节并随工程交付，云C01保存同一冻结文档JSON；不创建云媒体分发服务或伪造Engine检查点

decisions.subject: 固定前沿的时点观察
decisions.selected: Host为必要item/job/device状态改变赋连续record_sequence；TX06把新增记录、快照/接纳/cutoff/head原子发布，读取固定R/F/T，不从最终状态猜过去

decisions.subject: prepared与生产计时零点
decisions.selected: prepared保持clock_started=false和0观察毫秒；首次run固定唯一monotonic锚点，后续pause/resume不重置；启动后有效新观测才能参与派工

frozen_inputs.identity: exact session/epoch/project/Host source; no caller/grants/SelectedFileRef or token
documents: exact ModulePackage dependency closure with rights
execution_definitions consumed by actual Engine compilation including resolved overrides
frozen_inputs.references: RunInputRef frozen_project_file/frozen_scenario_file resolve to actual saved Versioned supporting documents; not arbitrary network or disk reads
preparation_ready: r0 initial state records and snapshot confirmed published
only then preparation Task returns prepared; no command published
frozen_inputs.cancellation: before dispatch only; unknown cloud outcome stays cancellation in progress, query original identity; settle stopped prefix and TX09 before releasing

clock.prepared: no running monotonic clock; coverage.clock_started=false, observed_until_host_ms=0
clock.activation: first accepted H03 run anchors once at Host monotonic Instant; initial queue/control states can share time0 by sequence
clock.pre_run_device_observation: C04可保存prepared原始遥测；run后只有精确ObservationProbe的新采样回应能更新Host资格，旧补发不续期
clock.pause_resume: pauses only new dispatch; elapsed real time continues, no reset or virtual jump
clock.cutoff: report_cutoff_ms counted from first run; existing drain/immutable cutoff semantics preserved
clock.restart: cannot recreate old monotonic epoch or resume Engine from archive

history.owner: single Host/Engine state, UI/cloud only projections
history.record_sequence: starts1; consecutive through Snapshot.observation_frontier; independent of DB ingress and business revision
history.initial: real initialized item/device states at time0 included in r0; not generated production acceptance
history.state_changes: 记录必要状态变更，包括Host probe发起/接纳及设备资格到期；到期是资格边界，不产生工艺完成/资源释放；读接口不推进时钟
history.publication: TX06 may skip intermediate snapshot rows only if all new observation records through F are present; identical record replay accepted; different payload conflicts
history.as_of: exact Snapshot R gives F and observed bound; select each object last (at_host_ms,record_sequence) with seq<=F, source revision<=R and time<=T
history.paging: fixed identity/R/F/T/filter; item/job/device/logical_work/attempt then stable object id, cursor binds original selection; no latest fallback

interfaces.local: H09 read_execution_view -> inputs or observations; no Engine execution or cloud I/O
interfaces.cloud: H08(inputs/observations) -> C16/C17, marked cloud source; missing local never silently becomes old cloud data
interfaces.asset: planned native project_read_execution_media_asset(ExecutionMediaAssetRequest) -> ArrayBuffer using actual primary UI authority and exact frozen AssetRef mapping
interfaces.asset_error: missing exact archived bytes gives MissingReference/unavailable; never current-module/new-version/remote-URL substitute

archive.root: Native-configured private managed execution directory with Host-allocated safe child paths; no caller path or session-id-as-path
layout: Versioned frozen project/scenario files named by RunInputRef
immutable snapshot files and exact asset copies
archive.manifest: existing DocumentRole.SupportingFile; typed execution docs use DocumentKind.Asset plus own document_kind/contract_version; frozen project/scenario keep typed DocumentKind; no FrozenRun role or RunResult
archive.index: ExecutionArchiveIndex pins identity/input/history/snapshot FileRefs; atomic archive additions follow current ProjectStore publication method
archive.reload: load and validate read-only records, sources and frontier; never auto-register active Engine, old grants or command execution
archive.compatibility_status: design direction only; actual archive save/reopen and generic parser coverage not yet verified

projection.source: execution separate from draft/local Run; exact input docs + R/F/T observed item/job/device/logical-work/attempt objects + provenance
projection.scene: existing frozen geometry and item owner/slot layout; BoundJob device mapping from actual record, no fake JobState
projection.timeline: new execution projection in existing dock; reuse time/row geometry utilities, preserve RunTimeline semantics
projection.working_progress: only admitted working/completed/waiting state; without actual device progress no nominal percentage or cycle-complete animation
projection.resource_intervals: Host-confirmed occupation/reservation clipped at selected time; no physical effective-work claim
projection.seek: changes observation only; no H01/H03/H04 or device command
projection.quality: reuse accepted media quality; missing media prevents corresponding Native acceptance rather than passing with a substitute

source_anchors.purpose: existing item/job history and actual snapshot; new external typed view needed
HostRun/history and frozen run additions are precedents, not execution DTOs
SupportingFile parsing and atomic archive additions
Run-bound frame sources, holder binding and slot layout
separate execution scene source; no RunResult cast
preserve existing Run timeline; execution projection separate
actual UI identity and exact AssetRef admission
cache source currently depends on Run ID

pending: v1-final project/device/model/port/media identities and current source rebase
actual Rust schema/TS generation and complete schema meta/instance validation
real local archive/Cloud transactions/H09/Native consumers and presented-frame evidence
Agent/report consumer field coverage and concrete PaaS/version/budget

design_cases.expected: 准备不就绪；不能将当前草稿当本会话输入

design_cases.trigger: 准备冻结后当前草稿或方案变化
design_cases.expected: 执行仍读原冻结文档，标明差异；不覆盖新草稿

design_cases.trigger: 原模块文件后来被替换
design_cases.expected: 读取本会话已复制归档字节，不读当前同路径内容
明确MissingReference/缺项，不换近似模型填通过
按实际授权拒绝，不把FileRef当读取权限
prepared不消耗观察窗；首次run才锚定0时刻
Host时钟不重置；无有效完成回执不产出

design_cases.trigger: 同毫秒多对象多次改变
design_cases.expected: 按固定F内record_sequence取最后合法状态，不丢因果
明确拒绝；不外推或回退到其他修订
所有必要状态记录前缀仍连续；历史时点不丢

design_cases.trigger: 记录重发或同序号不同内容
design_cases.expected: 相同幂等，不同内容冲突且不覆盖

design_cases.trigger: 观察记录/快照事务中途失败
design_cases.expected: 不移动head或暴露半个观察前缀
cursor选择不匹配拒绝，重新读取

design_cases.trigger: 末态物品已移交、回看开始时点
design_cases.expected: 显示当时holder/job状态，不拿末态猜过去
模型保留可证实状态，无名义百分比或虚假动作完成

design_cases.trigger: 拖动执行时间轴或关闭面板
design_cases.expected: 只改变观察，不提交设备命令或重跑Engine
只读来源和状态保持；不恢复旧授权或自动续跑

design_cases.trigger: 准备取消遇到云提交结果未知
design_cases.expected: 查询原身份并结清未派工前缀；不直接放弃占位

internal_engine_identity.virtual_api: existing EngineInput/RunResult callers retain virtual semantics
internal_engine_identity.external_owner: typed ExternalSession identity, never a temporary fake RunId
internal_engine_identity.shared_state: private common frozen-docs/stock/resources core; separate virtual/external wrappers may expose different result types, one active owner only
internal_engine_identity.source_evidence: engine.rs only uses input.run_id at current line2133 to build RunResult; external export must bypass that legacy result path
internal_engine_identity.implementation_freedom: private helper layout remains implementation choice; cannot duplicate stock or construct a RunResult for external observations
